answer: Sybil resistance follows from requiring each verified identity to complete a prescribed chain of dependent modular squarings, xᵢ₊₁ = xᵢ² mod N, before accepting its Wesolowski proof. Because every step depends on the previous result, one clone’s computation cannot be split across GPUs; multiple clones still require separate sequential timelines. Challenge domains such as garden, velvet, and violet prevent transcript reuse, imposing a physical time cost per identity.
